challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.codeDescription: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
challenge.passkeyDescription: Confirm your passkey to finish signing in.

setup.title: Set up Tilecast
setup.subtitle: Create the first owner account for this installation.

organizationName.title: What is this installation for?
organizationName.description: The organization name shown across Tilecast Studio.
organizationName.label: Organization name

ownerName.title: Who owns this installation?
ownerName.description: The first account is the Owner. This is your display name.
ownerName.label: Your name

username.title: Choose a sign-in name
username.description: You will type this every time you sign in to Studio.

password.title: Set the owner password
password.description: Local accounts never leave this server.

confirmPassword.title: Confirm the password
confirmPassword.description: Type it once more to catch typos before they lock you out.
confirmPassword.label: Confirm password

review.title: Review and create
review.description: Check the details before creating this installation.
review.passwordNote: The password is never shown again after this step.

validation.mfaCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app

enrollment.loadError: Sign-in security could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

welcome.description: This organization asks for a second step when you sign in. Setting it up takes about two minutes, and you only do it once.

blurbs.authenticator: Six-digit codes from an app on your phone.
blurbs.recovery: Printable codes that get you back in if you lose the app.
blurbs.passkey: Optional. Your fingerprint, face, or screen lock instead of a code.

authenticator.title: Add your authenticator app
authenticator.description: Scan this code with an app such as Aegis, Google Authenticator, or 1Password, then type the six-digit code it shows.
authenticator.manualKey: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand: <secretCode>{{secret}}</secretCode>

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: These are how you get back in if you lose your phone. Tilecast has no email reset, so keep them somewhere you can reach without this account.
recovery.passwordHint: Tilecast asks again before it issues codes.
recovery.shownOnceDescription: Tilecast stores only their hashes and cannot show them again. Each code works one time.

passkey.title: Add a passkey
passkey.description: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock, with no code to type. It counts as your second step on its own. You can add one later from My Account instead.

done.description: Next time you sign in, Tilecast asks for your second step after your password. You can change any of this from My Account.
